d: Bihar ke Mokama se purv vidhayak Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ki shadi sirph parivarik samaroh nahin, balki ek bhavy aayojan ke rup men charcha men rahi. Patna ke Nadwan ganv men hue is samaroh men lakhon ki bhir umri. VIP mehmanon ke lie helipaid banae gae aur kaee bare rajnitik chehre bhi samaroh men pahunche.
